description: This file contains a PHP trait 'InstallerCommandHelperTrait' that provides common helper methods used during the installation process of the OrangeHRM system, including input validation, system check display, and user interaction functions.

methods.name: getRequiredField
methods.description: Prompts the user for a required input field with optional validation.

methods.name: requiredValidator
methods.description: Validates that an answer is not null or empty, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: databasePortValidator
methods.description: Validates that the port number is within the acceptable range (0-65535) or empty.

methods.name: alphanumericValidator
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: emailValidator
methods.description: Validates that an email address is in proper format.

methods.name: phoneNumberValidator
methods.description: Validates that a phone number contains only specific characters.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a command-line option has been provided and is non-empty.

methods.name: drawSystemCheckTable
methods.description: Displays the results of system checks in a formatted table.

methods.name: startSection
methods.description: Starts a new console output section with a given step label.

methods.name: startStep
methods.description: Updates a console section with the current step being executed.

methods.name: completeStep
methods.description: Marks a step as completed in the console output.

methods.name: validateStrLength
methods.description: Ensures that a string does not exceed a specified maximum length.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks the password against strength policies and throws an exception if requirements are not met.
